pins.title: School garden biodiversity lesson: help children choose one action
pins.description: How can children turn a habitat observation into action? At the end of Operation: Hidden Habitat, ask which patch showed more signs of life. pins.title: Saltwater float experiment for kids: will the same grape float?
pins.description: How can we see what salt changes? With a grown-up, test the same grape in fresh water and in salt water. Add salt gradually, stir until it dissolves and record what happens. Changing the water while keeping the grape the same makes the comparison useful. Try the free Saltwater Float Test.
